dishes.name: Pfefferpotthast
dishes.desc: Westphalian beef stew with onions, bay leaf and plenty of pepper, long a Dortmund tavern dish served with potatoes or bread.

dishes.name: Töttchen
dishes.desc: Veal ragout in a tangy gravy made with vinegar and capers, a dish of Westphalia and the Ruhr.

dishes.name: Westphalian pumpernickel
dishes.desc: Dark rye bread steamed for many hours until sweet and soft. Eaten with ham, cheese or butter across the region.

dishes.name: Dortmunder Salzkuchen
dishes.desc: Yeast roll topped with salt, caraway and onion, a Dortmund bakery snack known as a beer-hall companion.

dishes.name: Westphalian ham
dishes.desc: Smoked and air-cured ham from Westphalian farms, sliced thin and served with pumpernickel.
